# freecenter_host_service (Resource)

State and startup policy of a service of an ESXi host (e.g. ntpd, TSM for the ESXi Shell). The service exists on the host regardless: destroying the resource leaves it as it is. The SSH service cannot be stopped or disabled, as FreeCenter manages the host through it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_id` (String)
- `key` (String) Service key as the host reports it, e.g. ntpd, TSM, TSM-SSH.

### Optional

- `policy` (String) Startup policy: on (start with the host) or off. When omitted the policy is not changed.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the service runs. When omitted the service is not started nor stopped.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <host_id>/<key>.
- `label` (String) Display name of the service.
